records.name: Stackt
records.tagline: On-demand storage and removals — flexible and adaptive
records.description: Stackt is a London technology-enabled moving and storage service with online booking, insurance, and professional movers. Storage from £1.44/week, moves from £49; £1M+ raised. Customers include UCL and Virgin Media.

records.name: Bolder
records.tagline: On-demand AI-assisted radiology reports in 24 hours
records.description: Bolder connects clinics and hospitals with AI-assisted radiologists on-demand via a double-read validation workflow. 2M+ studies, 1,000+ radiologists, trained on 300K+ cases. Backed by MSD, Philips, J&J.

records.name: Zibra AI
records.tagline: AI-Native Data Infrastructure  for Spatial and Physical AI
records.description: GPU-native data orchestration platform for physical and spatial AI. Spatial AI isn't compute-bound — it's data-bound. Massive volumetric datasets create a data gravity problem: I/O bottlenecks starve GPUs and stall training despite huge compute investment. Zibra removes that bottleneck — over 97% in size reduction, 600+ GB/s decompression, delivered in the compressed unified format directly into GPU. 40% better GPU utilization. 30% faster model convergence. This is the missing data layer.

records.name: FireTail
records.tagline: Enable secure AI adoption across your entire organization
records.description: One platform to discover, assess, and protect all AI usage across your organization. FireTail gives you complete coverage across every employee, browser, device, application, and agent. Get the visibility, security and control you need to enable AI innovation at scale. Blackhat USA & Asia 2025 Startup Spotlight Top 4; TechCrunch Disrupt 2024 Startup Battlefield 200; SOC 2 Type 2

records.name: VisaBot & xVisa
records.tagline: Visa Applications made easy
records.description: VisaBot is modernizing how the world obtains travel visas. Its' xVisa platform handles appointment bookings (via our Visabot), document checks, approval predictions, and full application processing - one place, fully automated, saving you days & weeks in wait times, for over 250 destinations across 35 countries. Making it as easy as booking a flight.

records.name: Bonsai Smart Wealth
records.tagline: Life changed. Your money didn't get the memo.
records.description: Bonsai is building the AI financial operating system for modern savers. One place for your money that connects accounts, goals, savings, investments and bigger decisions, all in one. Lily, your co-pilot, turns that full picture into a plan that keeps up as your income, spending and priorities shift. Whether you’re changing jobs, planning a move, building a buffer or putting more into your future, Bonsai helps you make smarter money moves with confidence. Your money, but smarter.

records.name: Parc AI
records.tagline: Park, walk away, and get on with your day
records.description: Parc detects when you leave your vehicle, understands the parking rules where you are, starts your parking session automatically, keeps it active while you’re away, and ends it when you return. Never get a parking fine again. It turns parking into something that just happens in the background. Parc is building the intelligence layer for the final step of every car journey.

records.name: SegmentStream
records.tagline: Marketing intelligence for the Agentic AI era
records.description: SegmentStream is a marketing intelligence engine for teams and AI agents. Cross-channel attribution, incrementality insights, forecasting, and budget optimization — all in one platform. Powering $100M+ in ad spend for leading startups and enterprises including Synthesia, DerTour, Raylo, Eneco, and SimpliSafe.

records.name: Payemoji
records.tagline: AI-powered payments and conversational commerce
records.description: AI-powered Fintech revolutionizing payments and conversational commerce. We empower any merchant handling CNP payments or refunds to deliver ultra-secure transactions, slash chargebacks to zero, and boost sales by transforming payments into conversations on everyday apps like WhatsApp.

records.name: Azoma
records.tagline: Syndication and Intelligence Layer for Agentic Commerce
records.description: Azoma is an end-to-end agentic commerce optimization platform that monitors and optimises brand visibility across Amazon Rufus, Walmart Sparky, ChatGPT Shopping and other AI shopping agents. Enterprise customers include Arla, Barilla, Bayer, Beiersdorf, Lipton, L'Oréal, Mars, Reckitt, Unilever, and Zappos.

records.name: Ask Silver
records.tagline: Free, straightforward scam checking in seconds
records.description: Ask Silver is an AI-powered scam detection service that analyzes screenshots, photos, phone numbers, and website links in under 30 seconds, returning a simple verdict based on hundreds of trusted sources. 40,000+ scams detected; endorsed by National Trading Standards and BBC; partnered with UK financial institutions. Free, also available via WhatsApp.

records.name: Systellar Space
records.tagline: The design platform for complex engineering systems
records.description: Systellar builds synapse, a unified engineering workspace combining system modeling, requirements, and documentation with version control for aerospace, defense, and industrial programs. Backed by Techstars, ESA BIC, Microsoft, NVIDIA.

records.name: Persistent Security Industries
records.tagline: Attack simulations that prove your defenses work
records.description: Persistent Security Industries offers the Nemesis BAS platform that continuously validates whether security controls hold up under real attack conditions.

records.name: TAMI
records.tagline: Your entire market. Identified, verified, delivered.
records.description: TAMI is an AI sales intelligence platform that scans 300M+ websites in real time to identify companies and verify contacts. 400M+ verified contacts, 90+ TB of data, 5% bounce rate. Free trial, Chrome extension, API, CRM integrations. Customers include Stripe, DPD, Trustpilot, Elavon.

records.name: Litero
records.tagline: Write up to 10x faster with an ethical AI writing partner
records.description: Litero is a source-based academic writing workspace with 100M+ academic sources, citation formatting, plagiarism and AI-detection tools. Loved by students at Harvard, Oregon, Michigan; trusted by teacher. Free tier + paid plan starting from $7.90/mo

records.name: PLAYBACK SPORTS AI
records.tagline: AI match capture and highlights for youth and amateur clubs
records.description: Playback delivers AI-powered match capture, automated highlights, and player profiling for sports academies and clubs. Combines in-house software with Veo/Spiideo hardware in a single OS for amateur and youth players. 75,000+ players globally, 25+ partner clubs (including Manchester City, the Junior Premier League), £750k+ saved for partners.

records.name: Stasher
records.tagline: Drop your bags, not your plans
records.description: Stasher is a global luggage storage marketplace with 10,100+ partner locations (hotels, shops, lockers) across hundreds of cities, starting at £2.99/day. Millions of bags stored to date; partners include Booking.com, Airbnb, Expedia, Klook, and Accor; covered by BBC, NYT, Forbes, TechCrunch.

records.name: AIRS ML
records.tagline: Edge AI that predicts machine failures
records.description: Machines don't just break. They whisper first — weeks before they fail. But standard monitoring samples are too slow to hear them, and cloud AI can't scale across thousands of distributed assets. AIRS ML creates edge AI devices that mount onto any asset — CNC machines, robotic arms, motors, spindles, pumps — and detects incipient faults weeks before failure. Runs entirely on-device at 100 kHz, air-gapped, no cloud required. Validated across assets and John Deere startup collaborator 2026.

records.name: ADIN.AI
records.tagline: AI operating system for enterprise marketing
records.description: ADIN.AI is an AI-native marketing platform combining analytics (SEE) and campaign management (MANAGE). Customers include L'Oréal, Vodafone, Under Armour, Prada, Publicis. Up-to-5x RoAS claims.

records.name: Sumvin
records.tagline: The permission layer for agent-driven finance
records.description: Sumvin is the credential and authorisation infrastructure that lets AI agents act on your finances within explicit, user-set boundaries. It connects your accounts and subscriptions, monitors balances, tracks spending, and manages renewals — all while giving agents scoped access. Pilot partner with Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect for agent payments; settlement layer runs on Sei.

records.name: LytteAI
records.tagline: Human-grade financial agents
records.description: LytteAI is building human-grade financial AI agents. More details at lytte.ai.

records.name: The Agentic Sales Engine by Crono
records.tagline: Where sales teams and AI agents work side by side.
records.description: Most sales tools help you manage pipeline. Crono helps you execute it. We’re introducing the Agentic Sales Engine: a new way to run sales where AI agents and humans work side by side. Crono unifies signals, data, and workflows into one execution layer. Instead of manual tasks, prospecting, enrichment, and outreach become coordinated workflows. Teams act on real-time signals, not guesswork, turning execution into revenue.

records.name: Asa by Spryt
records.tagline: The medical receptionist in your pocket
records.description: Asa, Spryt's AI virtual receptionist for medical clinics, automates booking, rescheduling, non-emergency medical transport and payments over WhatsApp/SMS and predicts no-shows and changes outcomes using behavioural insights. Mayo Clinic Platform Member/ Google Growth Academy/ NVIDIA Inception; NHS + US partnerships; GDPR/ DETAC/HIPAA compliant.

records.name: SahiRent
records.tagline: SahiRent — The rent transparency tool
records.description: SahiRent shows real rent prices paid by actual tenants in Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon & Delhi NCR. Check if your rent is fair, find 1BHK/2BHK/3BHK flats, compare locality rents, lookout for flatmates plan your locality according to your budget No brokers. No ads. Just honest data.
